semantics.definition: A panel that covers the whole window: a modal dialog, so the page behind cannot be reached, and Escape closes it.
semantics.responsibility: Be the one drawer every No Origins app uses. It changes only through a proposal you approve; Mero keeps the fingerprints of the version you approved, git keeps the code.

spec.job: Show an app’s menu, or another panel, where one pane fills the window.

arrival.grow: grows out of the button that opened it, and shrinks back into it

interaction.arriving: arriving, in 300 ms (at once with reduced motion)
interaction.leaving: leaving, in 200 ms (at once with reduced motion)
